Implemented in `game.js`:

- Enemies now spawn closer together and have no collision-separation behavior, so they can overlap and bunch up.
- Attacks are blocked while guarding. Starting a guard also cancels an active attack, for both keyboard and touch controls.
- Added more character details, including costume trim, seams, footwear, facial features, and a distinct accent for the boss.

**Checks:** `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed. I couldn’t capture a screenshot because `CAPTURE_URL` and `CAPTURE_DIR` aren’t set in the environment.
